6301.title: Skill refresh terminates idle provider descendants
6301.rootCauseOneLine: Idle skill-catalog invalidation shuts down the whole runtime; provider subprocess descendants are not counted as active work and are terminated by process-group cleanup.
6301.proposedFix: Design a provider-capability-aware in-place skill update, preserving existing sessions and staged roots. Codex already accepts skills/configure, but runtime process identity currently includes the roots. Verify catalog removal, busy siblings, provider fallback, and process survival before changing replacement policy.
6301.caveats: Real process lifecycle reproduced twice with production Codex bridge and trusted fake app-server; no live Codex/macOS shell-tool run. No simple fix because catalog lifetime and provider process identity span subsystems. Repro patch is inline per reports policy.
